messages.subject: Re: Milkweed seeds
messages.text:
Hi Susan,

Sorry for the long delay getting back to you, this isn't like us, things have been especially intense on our end. We don't currently offer mixed packets, each packet contains seeds from a single species. That said, nothing stops you from ordering a few different ones to build your own mix! We carry several species: Common milkweed (Syriaca), Butterfly milkweed (Tuberosa), Swamp milkweed (Incarnata), and a few others. You can browse them all here: https://lasclay.com/en/products/milkweed-seeds

We also carry cold-stratified seeds that are ready to sow if you'd like to skip the stratification step: https://lasclay.com/en/products/graines-semences-asclepiade-stratifiees-froid

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
